fact: A World Bank mission in February 2025 stressed the need to integrate the National ID system with the UBR and agreed to fast-track hiring a specialist to integrate the UBR with the NRIS and the payment gateway, which shows the link was not yet in place.
title: Digital Malawi Acceleration Project (DMAP, P505095): Aide-Mémoire, ID Technical Discussions Mission, February 10 to 19, 2025
